issues.description: LUA-16 ScriptErrorPayload.stack_trace is always empty on LuaJIT 2.1 — lua_getstack returns 0 after lua_pcall returns to C because the call frames are already unwound. The proper fix is to install debug.traceback as the errfunc argument to lua_pcall so the trace is captured while frames are still alive. Filed as GH-595 (https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/595) and queued for a separate WF-03 run. Does not block the LUA-16 release because error_kind classification and the script_error payload still construct correctly; this is a known limitation documented in TC-ISS-0625-LUA-16-int-01 with a comment explaining the assertion (== 0 today, > 0 after fix).
